integrity: General analytic proof; computational symbolic and numerical consistency checks accompany the result. No external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Critical linear feedback, integer groups 1<M<N, positive b,c,epsilon; a periodic annulus is proved only when 0<c<b Gamma((M-1)/(N-1)). Global interior first integral does not imply all interior trajectories are periodic. Later inaccessible closely related full text presents residual publication-priority uncertainty.
title: An exact conserved quantity and neutral oscillation annulus at critical collective-risk feedback
